instruction.name: setarmj
instruction.description: ARM-style set-if-condition: evaluate condition code `cond` against the flag register and write 1 or 0 to `rd`.

experiments.name: flag dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 5; li.d $r13, 7; li.d $r0, 0; x86mtflag $r0, 0xff; armmtflag $r0, 0xff' --asm 'armmtflag $r12, 0xff; setarmj $r12, 4'
experiments.notes: The closing flag transfer is 2 cycles and is subtracted.

latencies.notes: Latency from the condition flags to rd, closed by loading the flags into r12 with armmtflag (2 cycles subtracted).

notes: LBT conditional set of a byte from the flag register, measured with the flag register primed from a GPR in `--init`.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: setarmj $r4, 4; setarmj $r5, 4; setarmj $r6, 4; setarmj $r7, 4; setarmj $r8, 4; setarmj $r9, 4; setarmj $r10, 4; setarmj $r11, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 5; li.d $r13, 7; li.d $r0, 0; x86mtflag $r0, 0xff; armmtflag $r0, 0xff' --asm 'setarmj $r4, 4; setarmj $r5, 4; setarmj $r6, 4; setarmj $r7, 4; setarmj $r8, 4; setarmj $r9, 4; setarmj $r10, 4; setarmj $r11, 4'
throughput.notes: Eight conditional sets with distinct destinations, all reading the same flag state.
